<div style="margin:0 5px">'''Founder''' is a status obtained after purchasing the [[Store#Founders_Bundle|Founder's bundle]] from the [[Store]], which becomes available for purchase after buying the [[Store#Perk_Bundles|Perk bundles]]. It offers a vast array of benefits, including the [[#Discord_role|role]] on the official [https://discord.com/invite/t6Y6QRa game discord]. Some of the benefits are [[#Benefits|immediate]], while others like the [[#VIP_Lounge|VIP lounge]] or the [[#Founder_Supply_Drop|Supply drops]] are passive effects which work over time. Founder costs $24.99 USD or approximately the same amount as the Perk Bundles combined in the currency you use.
Total amount of Founder bundle owners - 66942 (last updated - Oct 9)
</div></div>

==Benefits==
===Immediate Rewards===
*3500 Gems
*4 [[Chests#Relic_Chests|Mythic Chests]]
*250 [[Chests#Relic_Chests|Relic Chests]]

===Permanent Effects===
*[[Bombs#tabber-Founders_Bomb|Founder's Bomb]]<ref>Founder bomb cap is unrelated to normal bomb cap. Instead, founder bomb cap is the current number of founders for the game, usually updated manually by the devs with each patch.</ref>
*Founder [[Supply drop|Supply Drops]]
*[[Founder#VIP_Lounge|Founder Lounge]] Access
*1.1x Bomb Recharge Rate
*Offline Cap doubled to 24 hours
*[[Freebie|Freebie Chest]] restores 60 seconds quicker
*x1.25 Pickaxe Damage
*x1.25 Bomb Damage
*x1.25 Exp Gain
*Bomb Capacity increased by 100
*10x [[Craft Chance]] +2%
*Founders Stats Page + Badge
*Founder Status Discord Rank

===Others/Unlisted===
*Display the VIP Points value for each [[Value|IAP]] (See VIP Lounge)
*Display an additional [[Value|Value Pack]] in the shop
*Ability to purchase 3rd [[#Limited_Time|Event bundle]] during [[Events]]
*Can buy unlimited amount of [[Store#MythicGiftPack|Mythic Gift Pack]] resource pack in Store (IAP - Instead of only 3).
**Before [[Update:V2.2.1]], the Mythic Gift Pack was not accessible for F2P at all
*A special [[Codes|Code "FOUNDERCODE"]]

<references />

==Discord role==
In order to claim the Discord role, after purchasing the Founder's bundle:

# Go to the Options menu
# Select the Enter Code button
# Type in the code "Founder"
# Submit a new ticket in the #founder-role-request channel
# Include the details from the code section.

==VIP Lounge== 
Buying the Founders Bundle unlocks the VIP Lounge. As you buy [[Value|In App Purchases]] you gain VIP Lounge points. The amount of points you gain varies based on the cost and currency you use. When you gain enough points, you reach a new tier. This upgrades all unlocked effects and unlocks the new tier effect.

==Founder Supply Drop==
[[File:Supply_Drop.png|left]]
Founders get supply drops based on a timer that is not affected by game speed. It drops crates containing rewards that scale with game progression. For a supply drop to spawn, the previous supply drop's crates must have already been collected, they will not stack. Tier 2 unlocks a chance for double supply drops. Tier 7 unlocks a chance for triple supply drops, which can be hit alongside a double resulting in a max of 6 crates at once. Tier 11 unlocks a chance for golden supply drops, this chance rolls per crate in the drop and any crate that turns golden will contain 5x the amount of each reward.

=== Jackpots ===
Collecting a supply drop will trigger a chance at receiving a jackpot as well. If triggered, a notification will appear stating [[File:Founder Jackpot.png|16px]] "You hit the [odds] jackpot for [reward]!"

In the jackpots table, Highest World Multiplier (Abbreviated to HWM) is shown below.
